original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Independent exact replay of idle-axis redistribution on all 112 T740 port recipes for owner replica zero: test every eligible one-axis move among children (8,10,12,13); test the common-axis paired transfer from children (8,10) to (12,13) and its reverse; then use OR-Tools CP-SAT to optimize assignments of the 192 residual-axis tokens among those four children, preserving hosted-axis and pairwise orthogonality constraints with rank cap 51. Replay the minimum-move assignment attaining the best local rank-moment profile at its nominated Fourier characters.
scope_change_reason: PR3187 gives an exact counterexample to PR3184’s first single-stream star move. After the single and paired census, the remaining matched-swap/longer-cycle question is naturally an assignment problem: an incoming vector may become feasible if a nonorthogonal destination vector leaves at the same time. OR-Tools is used only for candidate nomination and the local moment objective; the source-bound exact replay remains the physical acceptance test. The user explicitly favored OR-Tools for optimization.
bottleneck_link: A better rank histogram changes the moment only if the exact hosted eight-stream physical operator is preserved. The CP-SAT screen finds the most uneven feasible four-child rank profile under the stated token, orthogonality and rank-cap model, then rejects its minimum-move representatives on all 112 ports. The local profile shift is not a new provider moment or κ.
stop_rule: Authenticate the complete T740 fill and all 112 recipes; verify positive baseline controls; enumerate eligible single-axis and paired transfers; for each port solve the residual-axis assignment model to optimality for the local moment surrogate and minimum move count, then exact-replay the nominated candidate on the recorded character set. Stop this bounded screen at the first mismatch for each candidate. Do not claim all assignments at the optimal rank profile fail, and do not generalize to other child pairs, replicas, or all operator-preserving assignments.
evidence: verify.py authenticates the PR3148 T740 payload SHA256 8f4d6965…e00, checks the baseline on 147 modes for port 0 plus the zero-character identity for all ports, and tests 21,504 single-axis candidates (192 per port), 2,688 forward paired candidates, and 2,688 reverse paired candidates across all 112 port recipes for owner replica zero. Every candidate changes the exact Gaussian-integer stream matrix at its own Fourier character; the paired candidates are pairwise isolated and any simultaneous nonempty subset of that restricted class retains a counterexample. Separately, optional CP-SAT 9.11.4210 runs 112 rank-assignment models to optimality. Each finds profile [51,51,51,39] from [48,48,48,48] with 12 moved tokens; the first tested exact mismatch is at character 1, 2 or 32 on every port. This is one minimum-move representative per port, not an exhaustive search of assignments at that profile. No new κ, supplier admission, or selected-frontier change.
